guard: the served spawn door hands the bound the caller the broker pinned on the request subject
why: The bound exempts a spawn with no authenticated caller, the manager's own composition root.
D1 drops the caller from the served door's handoff to startAgent, so every served static spawn
would read as the composition root and pass unbounded. D2 drops it from define-persona's
handoff, so a served definer would put any capability into a persona.

mutations.name: D1 drop the served caller from the handoff
mutations.expectRed: a served spawn wider than the spawner is refused at the door, naming the part

mutations.name: D2 drop the served caller from define-persona
mutations.expectRed: a define-persona capability the definer does not hold is refused at the door, naming it
